description: Prangins Castle is the eighteenth-century French-style house above Lake Geneva in the municipality of Prangins, with a formal garden and a park on the slope. It has been part of the Swiss National Museum since 1998, and the frame stays on the exterior. It is not the white lakeside castle at Nyon. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 15°C, with a light wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
